name: counters-spec-lint
description: Pinned Spectral toolchain for the openapi-validate CI job. The committed lockfile freezes the entire dependency tree so a malicious or broken upstream release of a transitive dependency cannot reach the spec-lint gate. The @asyncapi/specs override pins 6.11.1, the last known-good release: 6.11.2 was a malicious supply-chain publish (the AsyncAPI npm compromise of 2026-07-14 that shipped the Miasma credential-stealing RAT as an install-time dropper). Spectral pulls @asyncapi/specs transitively for AsyncAPI support the OpenAPI lint never uses. Regenerate with `npm install` here and commit the lockfile.
